units.title: Health and Safety in Network Support

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Health and Safety Regulations and Requirements

performance_criteria.description: Identify kezy legislation, regulations, and standards relevant to health and safety in the workplace.
Explain the roles and responsibilities of both employers and employees
Describe the legal consequences of non- compliance with health and safety regulations in network-related work.

learning_outcomes.description: Be Able to Identify and Mitigate Workplace Hazards

performance_criteria.description: Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential hazards within a network installation site or work area.
Recommend appropriate control measures to mitigate identified risks, including the use of signage, barriers, and equipment.
Monitor work practices to ensure the consistent application of safety protocols during network installation and maintenance activities.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement Safe Working Practices and Emergency Procedures

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the correct use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and tools while working in a network environment.
Follow proper procedures for responding to emergencies
Develop and communicate a safety plan that includes reporting incidents and unsafe conditions to the appropriate authorities.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the Principles of Effective Teamwork

performance_criteria.description: Identify the characteristics of a successful team and the roles each member plays within a network support team.
Explain the importance of clear communication, active listening, and mutual respect in a team setting.
Describe different team dynamics, including collaboration, decision- making, and accountability in network- related tasks.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Problem- Solving and Conflict Resolution Skills in Team Settings

performance_criteria.description: Participate in team discussions to analyze network-related problems and propose solutions collaboratively.
Address conflicts that arise within the team in a professional manner, using mediation and negotiation techniques to reach a resolution.
Evaluate the effectiveness of team problem-solving strategies and suggest improvements to enhance team performance in future projects.

learning_outcomes.description: Exhibit Leadership and Support Team Development

performance_criteria.description: Take initiative in organizing team tasks, delegating responsibilities according to team members' strengths and skills.
Provide constructive feedback and support to team members, encouraging continuous improvement and skill development.
Foster a positive team environment by promoting inclusivity, recognizing individual contributions, and motivating the team to achieve set goals.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the Importance of Effective Communicatio n in the Workplace

performance_criteria.description: Explain the impact of clear and concise communication on team performance, project success, and client satisfaction.
Identify barriers to effective communication in a technical workplace and strategies to overcome them.
Describe how cultural differences, language, and technical jargon can influence communication in a diverse workplace.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Effective Verbal and Non-Verbal Communicatio n Skills

performance_criteria.description: Use appropriate tone, clarity, and technical language when communicating with different stakeholders (e.g., team members, clients, management).
Demonstrate active listening by accurately interpreting and responding to verbal and non-verbal cues during discussions and meetings.
Apply non-verbal communication techniques, such as body language and eye contact, to enhance message delivery and understanding.

learning_outcomes.description: Be Able to Use Digital Tools for Professional Communication

performance_criteria.description: Select and use appropriate digital communication tools (e.g., email, instant messaging, project management platforms) to exchange information effectively within a network support team.
Compose clear and professional emails, reports, and other written correspondence to ensure effective communication with stakeholders.
Ensure confidentiality and security of sensitive information when communicating through digital platforms, adhering to organizational policies and regulations.
